rationale: The plan correctly uses DESeq2 Wald with design ~ batch + condition, control as reference, batch never applied to counts (ComBat explicitly avoided), and includes a sensible sensitivity comparison against a batch-free model and limma-voom. QC precedes testing with PCA/heatmap colored by both condition and batch, contingency table check, and PC-factor association stats. Filtering (>=10 counts in >=6 samples) is minimal and justified relative to group size; normalization is internal to DESeq2/edgeR (VST only for QC/visualization, TMM for voom), with no pre-adjusted counts fed into a count model. BH FDR at stated thresholds with apeglm shrinkage for ranking/display while keeping unshrunken stats for testing is well specified. Enrichment is appropriately warranted and executed with full ranked list, stated ranking metric, named human collections, size window, ORA fallback conditioned on list size. Reporting is thorough: versions of packages, thresholds, gene counts at multiple cutoffs, and design caveats (residual df, Cook's distance, batch power impact) are all explicitly addressed.
